content:
marie: Ran nsys diff between master@abc123 and rollout@def456 on a 64-token seq batch=32 workload. Observed 18% tail p99 latency regress. nsys trace: flash_attn_v2::forward shows increased device memory write time.

nsys-bot: link: https://internal/nsys/trace/2959876543

devin: can you paste the kernel timeline? did kernel selector flip to flashv2?

marie: kernel timeline excerpt:
```
Time(ms)  Kernel                         Calls  Avg(ms)  Total(ms)
0.12      flash_attn_v2_fwd               64     0.9      57.6
0.12      fused_attn_fwd                  128    0.35     44.8
0.12      kv_cache_write                  320    0.07     22.4
```
Notable: flash_attn_v2 shows ~2x global write bandwidth vs master.

ryan: nvprof sampling showed high SM stall due to l2_write_back. Could be uncoalesced stores from new write path.

sam: any change in batching heuristic? If batch selector increased per-batch sequence packing, kv writes could be larger, causing more serialization.

marie: Yes — recent heuristic change (PR #482) tries more aggressive packing for <seq<128. Reproducer below:
```
python repro.py --model gpt-3-small --seq 64 --batch 32 --use_flashv2
nsys profile -t cuda,osrt -o trace.nsys -- python repro.py ...
```

elaine: try toggling USE_WRITE_COALESCE env var to 0 and rerun nsys. If it improves, then write coalescing/stride logic broke.

marie: quick diff toggling coalesce=0 reduces flash_attn_v2 write time by ~40% in local nsys sample. Will collect perfetto capture and kernel memcopy stats.

ryan: also run `cuda-memcheck --tool racetrack`? maybe banking conflict triggers extra writes.

marie: attaching sampled perfetto timeline snippet: link: https://internal/perfetto/trace/2959876543

devin: next steps: 1) run nvprof with MEMOPS tracking 2) add NVTX around kv write path 3) bisect PR #482 to pinpoint code change

sam: if it's batching causing bigger KV footprints, maybe change to cap pack_size for flashv2 when kv_write_rate > X.

marie: plan: run nvprof MEMOPS + l2 counters tonight, open a follow-up thread with raw counters. Thanks all :thumbsup:
